title: The golden set of finance questions the own agent is scored on
description: Each case is a question asked as a persona, the verified query of the metric context that answers it, and the expected result frozen as data: the columns and rows that query returned on the persona's database over the committed sample build when the case was written, or `abstains` when the right answer holds no figure. agent/evals/score.py compares the expected result with what the SQL an answer cites returns when the scorer runs it again; how it compares is stated there. `uncovered` names each headline metric with a verified query that no case covers, and why.

value.description: One value of a result row: a number (compared as a double), a text, or null.

columns.description: The result's column names, in the order the query returns them.

rows.description: The result's rows, in any order; a row returned twice is listed twice.

abstains.description: The right answer cites no query that ran: the asking persona may not run the query.

query.description: A verified query id of semantics/context.json.
